Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using malicious Rich Text Format (RTF) documents exploiting Windows zero-day vulnerability CVE-2022-30190 (Follina)
Deployment of PowerShell script as final payload to check for virtual machines, steal browser and mail client data, collect system information, and exfiltrate data to attacker-controlled server
Impacted Systems: Browsers: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, Opera, Yandex, Vivaldi, CentBrowser, Comodo, CheDot, Orbitum, Chromium, Slimjet, Xvast, Kinza, Iridium, CocCoc, AVAST Browser
Mail clients and apps: Mozilla Thunderbird, Windows Live Mail, MailMaster
Other apps: Netsarang, Filezilla, ToDesk, WeChat, Oray SunLogin RemoteClient, ServU, Putty, FTP123, WinSCP, RAdmin, Microsoft Office, Navicat
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious RTF documents exploiting MSDT remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2022-30190
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell payload harvesting browser passwords and system information
Phishing emails with salary increase promises as bait
